forwardToDetail.text:
HeritageVerse
EXPLORE

BACK TO EXPLORE

FORT AND PALACE

Agra Fort

Agra, Uttar Pradesh

A Mughal citadel containing palaces, audience halls and mosques within red sandstone walls.
[1]

Save favorite
Mark visited

Save this place or mark it as visited to find it again later.

Gallery

No verified media is available yet.

Overview

A Mughal citadel containing palaces, audience halls and mosques within red sandstone walls.
[1]

History

A major Mughal imperial fortress developed from the 16th century, with notable additions under Shah Jahan.
[1]

Cultural significance

The fort and nearby Taj Mahal together express the scale and artistic achievement of Mughal rule.
[1]

Architecture

Red sandstone enclosure with palaces including Jahangir Palace and Khas Mahal, audience halls and mosques.
[1]

Timeline

1983 CE
